calculation_handling.description: Despite 200.5.10.1(1) and 200.5.10.11(1)(C), if a lot has an ancillary building containing a laneway suite, no parking spaces are required for any dwelling units and secondary suites in a detached house, semi-detached house, townhouse, duplex, triplex or fourplex on the same lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the Chapter 200 parking requirements for the main building's units when a laneway suite exists (user input has_laneway_suite; no lot_condition token).

calculation_handling.description: Despite 200.5.10.1(1) and 200.5.10.11(1)(C), no parking space is required for a laneway suite.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the Chapter 200 parking requirement for the laneway suite itself.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building containing a laneway suite must have at least two bicycle parking spaces, located within the suite, any required separation distance, or the required setbacks for the laneway suite building.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'two' written as 2. The location options are not checked.

150.8.80.1(1).explanation: If the lot has a laneway suite, no car parking is required for the laneway suite or for the units and secondary suites in the house on the same lot.

150.8.80.1(2).explanation: A laneway suite needs at least two bicycle parking spaces, inside the suite or within its required setbacks or separation area.
